versions.changelog:
Major update: Skill Consolidator 2.0.0 introduces automated skill scanning, conflict detection, comprehensive reporting, and safe cleanup workflows for AI Agent skills.

- Now automatically scans and consolidates skills, rules, and commands across multiple AI Agent platforms.
- Detects name conflicts, functional overlaps, trigger phrase collisions, and version differences.
- Generates detailed cleanup reports and organized skill indexes for easy reference.
- Only performs actual cleanup actions (like merging or disabling skills) after explicit user confirmation.
- Supports both automated and manual fallback workflows for environments without Node.js.
- Compatibility expanded to a wide range of popular AI Agent tools.
